headline: Cherki will start vs Ipswich in predicted XI
body: Manchester Evening News, 17 Oct 2026 04:30 BST: Rayan Cherki deserves another shot from the beginning vs Ipswich; predicted XI includes Cherki. City predicted XI: Donnarumma; Nunes, Khusanov, Guehi, Gvardiol; Fernandez, Anderson; Ndiaye, Cherki, Doku; Haaland.
